description: I am a diploma student at SIET, Tiruchirappalli, and I’m excited to be participating in the NASA Hackathon. It’s a great opportunity to learn new things, explore creative ideas, work with others, and gain experience by solving real-world problems. I look forward to challenging myself, improving my skills, and making the most of this experience.
summary: Follow a child as they play, NOVA: Mission Mars, making choices that guide Nova and the crew on an Earth-to-Mars adventure. The child helps the rocket launch from Earth, powers the ship with solar wings, protects the crew from a solar flare, sends a radio warning home, and guides a safe landing on Mars. Intercut the child’s real gameplay with cinematic story scenes, then end with the child exploring Mars alongside the rover crew. A warm, exciting family adventure about curiosity, teamwork, and space science.
